title: Tak & Lug
extract:
Tak & Lug is a  Grineer Sword and Shield. Heavy Attack throws the shield which explodes thrice inflicting forced  Blast procs before returning.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage, has innate  polarity, and a #Unique Trait.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high block angle (70°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
High status chance (31.00%)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (70°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)

Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (70°)

Above average attack range (2.50 m)

Acquisition
Tak & Lug's blueprint and components are dropped by  Ghoul Auger and  Ghoul Devourer that appear in the Plains of Eidolon, Ghoul Purge Bounties, and Disruption Olympus on Mars.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.
Acquisition Tip: Distruption mission on Olympus, Mars is rich with ghouls. Also, there is a chance that one of the conduits will be "Ghoul Eruption" which will make the mission more like a ghoul arena. If this conduit is not the last one of the round, it is advised to let it be destroyed and continue farming without finishing the round. A  Nekros equipped with  Slash weapons will increase the drop chance. Also,  Tonkkatt parts will drop during this farm.

Unique Trait
Heavy Attack throws the shield, which travels 7m and explodes 3 times dealing damage in a 3m radius around the shield as well as to enemies between the user and the shield, before returning. This is not considered a projectile, but a melee attack with a far-reaching hitbox. The shield aims where the warframe aims (which is not always where player camera is looking).

A Sliding Heavy attack (W +Ctrl +MMB ) does not throw the shield.
All three explosions inflict a forced  Blast proc.
The shield itself also deals damage but does not force a  Blast proc.
The shield is thrown horizontally in front of the warframe. If the warframe's elevation changes during the heavy attack, the shield will descend/ascend accordingly.
If the warframe pans right or left during the heavy attack animation, the shield will likewise sweep and can hit additional targets.
Panning the shield throw will worsen single-target damage as explosions are spread over an area.
To hit enemies above you, the shield can be foced into a vertical projectory by jank warframe animation exploits, namely Aerial Heavy Attack:
Start the Heavy attack (MMB ) wind-up animation.
Perform a Bullet Jump (W +Ctrl +Space ) before the shield is thrown.
Aiming the bullet jump or varying the timing between steps 1 and 2 will change the angle at which the throw begins.
The warframe will usually start falling mid-throw, resulting in a hit above and below the starting angle and a downward bullet jump.
The post-throw bullet jump can be interrupted with a Slam Attack, or end very quickly if the starting angle was low and the warframe remained close to the ground.
Attack Speed mods will make the throw, explosions, and return faster.
Melee Range mods will increase the distance traveled by the heavy attack, and radius of the explosion.

Notes
The heavy attack is not an actual glaive throw, only a very long range melee strike. This results in unusual behavior such as it responding to post-throw reticle movement in the horizontal plane, range effecting the distance 'traveled' by the throw and AOE radius, and being locked to the player's current vertical position rather than displaying flight characteristics.

Trivia
Tak & Lug was first introduced in the Galleon of Ghouls Tactical Alert, available from the the second and third weeks (May 9th to May 12th, 2025 and May 16th to May 19th, 2025). The first completion of the second Alert awarded the main blueprint, attached to an inbox message from  Councilor Vay Hek, while every subsequent completion of the Alert awarded a random component.

Bugs
In-game, the Heavy Attack damage is displayed as 1,773 x4, the actual value is 591 x4 for a total of 2,364 damage.
1,773 is the combined total damage of all 3 explosions that inflict  Blast procs.
